title: Existence of all-stage closed direct-image presentations
statement: For a field $k$, a prime number $\ell$ invertible in $k$, an algebraically closed coefficient field $\Omega$ over $\mathrm{Padic}(\ell)$, separated finite-type quasi-compact $k$-schemes $Z,X$, and a closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ over $k$, there exists a compatible presentation of the finite, integral, rational, and algebraically closed direct images, with all comparison squares and scalar coherences recorded in the compatible presentation data.

proof.text: Construct the requested compatible restrictions by the closed-support, recollement, coefficient-comparison, scalar-localization, and common-stage arguments of the parent proof. The corresponding Hom maps are bijective and the adjunction-unit assertion follows by Yoneda.
